authorization: User requested full benchmark and validation and promotion; explicitly reiterated different TTS/STT models and promote when done.

stt: English Nemotron0.6B MLX8bit if compatible runtime; otherwise retain named integration failure and use Granite TurboCTC as additional arm

control: Existing Parakeet Metal / Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 MLX4bit / Kokoro0.8.2; contemporaneous runs, not historical scores.
latency_policy: Measure cold, warm p50/p95 and chunk gaps. No old20% slowdown limit; quality-first preference. Actual client deadlines/cancellation remain hard integration limits.

capacity_points: 8K prompt/4608 total output only for admitted reasoning arms
llm_schedule.capacity_policy: Strict request canaries and output controls; failed cells performance-ineligible.
llm_schedule.direct_preflight: all supported functional checks including shared-prefix tools x3, streaming and result continuation
llm_schedule.historical_exact_suite: Retain original score and run separately; new semantic validator frozen before inference.

preferences.priority: Best voice and answer quality, even if slower

promotion: Authorized winning exact configuration only after reviewable machine evidence and required blind/user-client coverage; use preview/apply and restore on post-cutover failure. Provisioning/client changes only where affected.
rollback: Retain byte-exact production service definitions, manifests, voice config and runtime identity in protected host state. Managed lifecycle only; one candidate and one cache writer at a time.

sampling.reasoning_budget_status: separately admitted and verified; no claim from xhigh external scores

scope: PRIVATE_IDENTITY_REDACTED local English personal/noncommercial voice assistant

stt_schedule.supplemental_population: Deterministic LibriSpeech English holdout across clean/other; user-microphone coverage separate and unresolved unless supplied/recorded with explicit participation.

tts_schedule.audio_artifacts: Outside Git; retain hashes and path metadata.
tts_schedule.listening: Blind counterbalanced paired samples, user judge, no evaluated-model self-grading.
tts_schedule.matched_reference_cloning: Separate optional arm, never compare as equivalent to Kokoro native voice.

winner_rules.combined: Exact passed component combination requalifies full client/interrupt/stability contract; no automatic substitutions.
winner_rules.llm: All absolute gates pass; independent blinded answer-quality preference or improved held-out correct-task rate. No baseline failure relaxes the gate.
winner_rules.no_winner: Keep existing component; never force failed candidate promotion.
winner_rules.stt: Passing candidate with lowest paired primary-human micro-WER; report bootstrap paired uncertainty. Tie/overlap retains control unless critical-word/endpointing benefit independently demonstrated.
winner_rules.tts: Passing configuration with user blind preference >=60% of non-tied pairs and Wilson95 lower bound >50%; ambiguous comparison requires user explicit preferred voice among valid configurations. No naturalness winner inferred from ASR alone.
